## Checklist

- [ ] I built the project and it compiles (`cmake --build build`).
- [ ] The test suite passes (`./build/shhterm_tests` or `ctest --test-dir build`).
- [ ] If I changed the protocol or crypto, I ran `node tools/interop_test.mjs` and kept the C++ and JavaScript implementations in sync.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for my change where it makes sense.
- [ ] I did not commit any secrets (certs, keys, tokens) — these are git-ignored.
- [ ] My code follows the existing style and I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
